title: Release-candidate qualification runs as parallel parts within 30 minutes and no workflow job has a longer limit
description: Release-candidate qualification runs as parallel parts within 30 minutes and no workflow job has a longer limit
acceptance_criteria: A release candidate qualifies when ten parts pass, five on each of Ubuntu and macOS, each within a 30-minute limit; a platform whose parts are incomplete, failed, bound to another candidate, or whose test slices do not add up to the whole list is not qualified; no workflow job declares a limit above 30 minutes; and the lane can be rehearsed without a candidate

answers.constraints: SPEED-2.b.2 (no test dropped or weakened); REQ-github-007 (one immutable candidate, both platforms green, pins and publication-time revalidation unchanged); the release lane restores caches and never saves them; ci.yml keeps no path filter and no required check depends on the rehearsal
